title: Preset browser, audition GUI wiring, Processor/Editor/CMakeLists integration
description:
Fan-in phase owner: wire Profiles/Tuning, factory presets, A/B crossfade/bypass, rejected-signal audition, and CMake sources into PluginProcessor and PluginEditor (CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.5, §21.3 header, §22–§25).

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Profiles.* and Source/TuningProfiles.* from j.1
- Source/StateManager.* A/B/crossfade APIs from j.2
- Resources/Presets/*.json from j.3 and StateManager factory loader
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock / APVTS / getStateInformation paths
- Source/PluginEditor.cpp and Source/GUI/MainHeader.* for existing preset/profile/A/B placeholders
- Source/GUI/DiagnosePage.* for rejected-signal audition controls if stubbed
- Source/ParameterIDs.h audition rejectedMode and stateFilterMode IDs
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources patterns from prior phases

PluginProcessor.cpp (sole processor owner this phase):
- Register/use Profiles + TuningProfiles when profile/tuning parameters change (message thread) without audio-thread allocations
- Consume StateManager crossfade metadata in processBlock: click-safe equal-power or linear crossfade when switching A/B; apply click-free latency-correct bypass path (dry aligned to plugin latency)
- Rejected-signal audition (r = x - y topology appropriate): honor rejectedMode (off/all/fullBand/weight/voice/hiss/hissCurtain/noiseModel/key) and stateFilterMode (off/hold/sustain/release/closed) so only matching rejected material is heard when auditioning
- Load factory preset from Resources when StateManager/header requests; apply through APVTS safely
- Ensure Profiles.cpp and TuningProfiles.cpp are available via CMake (below)

PluginEditor.cpp (+ header widgets only as already owned paths allow):
- Preset browser in header: list factory presets by category, load on selection, indication of dirty/user state if already patterned
- Profile selector bound to profile parameter / Profiles catalog
- A/B buttons: switch, copy A→B using StateManager
- Wire rejected-signal audition controls on Diagnose (or menu) to audition parameters; clear indication that output is audition/bypass of wet when listening rejected
- Do not redesign full LookAndFeel; only wire missing callbacks/components into existing shell

CMakeLists.txt (sole owner this phase):
- Add Source/Profiles.cpp and Source/TuningProfiles.cpp to plugin and test targets as needed
- Ensure Resources/Presets are installed/copied or listed for standalone discovery if the project already has a resources pattern; minimal additive lines only

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.cpp applies profile/tuning defaults when those parameters change
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp implements click-safe A/B crossfade using StateManager switch metadata
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp implements click-free latency-correct bypass path
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp routes rejected-signal audition according to rejectedMode and stateFilterMode parameter IDs
Source/PluginEditor.cpp wires preset browser, profile selector, and A/B controls to StateManager/Profiles/factory presets
CMakeLists.txt lists Profiles.cpp and TuningProfiles.cpp on the plugin and/or test targets
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite Profiles or TuningProfiles algorithms beyond include/wire usage
rewrite StateManager A/B internals (call public APIs only)
restructure unrelated CMake targets beyond additive source/resource lines

allowed: apply short equal-power or linear A/B crossfade envelope in processBlock
audition by swapping output buffer to residual when rejectedMode != off
minimal editor callback wiring without new multi-file GUI framework
forbidden: move parameter inventory ownership out of ParameterIDs
delete existing GUI pages from prior phases
introduce a second state serializer parallel to StateManager
